comments.value: I am having similar on latest beta, the haptics are still there but are very weak compared to previous betas and live. I am also using CV1 controllers on steamvr.

Ah, wait a sec, this is for the Rift, not the Quest. Sorry!
Reopening and updating internal tracking.

Using a CV1 and SteamVR, we were able to test using 1243. We were unable to reproduce the problem.
Haptics are all working correctly. Haptics aren't weaker or missing.
Can you retest and provide more info if possible?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: 
I tested both Rift CV1 and Quest 1 via Quest Link cable.
Both Oculus native and SteamVR VRChat builds.
Haptics strength for Rift CV1 and Quest was about same for all test cases. Haptics on Oculus live build was a bit stronger compared to SteamVR live build.
Results:
Oculus native Live - haptics present.
Oculus native Beta - haptics very weak.
SteamVR Live - haptics present, a bit weaker than Oculus native Live build.
SteamVR Beta - haptics completely missing.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: The UI, pickup and avatar haptics all don't work at all. the only vibration is when you pull trigger or grip. all haptics work perfect when swapping back to live. rift cv1 and steamvr     UPDATE I tested with my HTC vive and all haptics worked great on vive.
I just tested further and only haptic feedback on beta is when you pull trigger or grip all other haptics are completely gone. All haptics work great with my Vive and Vive wands.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I'm having this same issue, and I use a Rift S. I can confirm that this is what's happening to me too, where the beta seems to disable it completely when launched through SteamVR. I haven't tried the Oculus builds yet, but the SteamVR statements line up very well with my experience.
This has happened to me twice now on a CV1 and it started with haptics getting really weak. Gonna try to see if I can reproduce the problem tomorrow.

Ok after further testing I have no haptics at all for pickups, avatars or ui. Probably didn't notice before. I tested every setting related and restarted multiple times. I also tested the haptics with an udon script and could feel extremely weak haptics on my right controller.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Still happening on 1244

Note that it works fine with the same setup but using ALVR instead of Link

comments.value:
Same for me, Quest 1 over oculus link, usb 2.0 cable, running through SteamVR. Works fine over ALVR/VirtualDesktop, but not over official oculus link.
No haptics whatsoever from VRC except those generated by SteamVR itself (steamvr trigger pulls, steamvr menu, etc). No menu haptics, no udon haptics, no avatar haptics.
see similar post here https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1243-haptics-on-oculus-gone

For those still experiencing these issues on Live (now that the Beta has moved to Live), please post a response to me here with this format:
**Is your sensitivity and haptic strength on max?** If not, turn it all the way up.
**What build are you on?**
**Which haptics don't work?** UI, Interaction, Avatar
**Do Avatar Dynamics systems still work?** (Contacts, Receivers, PhysBone interaction, etc)
**What HMD are you using?**
**What controllers are you using?**
**Are you playing VRChta on a PC or are you playing on Quest standalone without a linked PC?**
**If you are on PC, how is your HMD connected to your PC?**
**If you are streaming from your PC to a standalone headset, what application are you using to stream?**
